review_scope.description: Bounded shared courthouse-access and clerk civil operational baseline for Santa Rosa County, First Judicial Circuit of Florida.
excluded: Litigation merits, forms inventory, criminal/family manuals, fees/deadline analysis

courthouse.name: Santa Rosa County Courthouse
courthouse.hours: Monday through Friday: 8:00 a.m. – 4:30 p.m. Closed on weekends and court-observed holidays.
courthouse.parking: Free public parking along the frontage of the courthouse, unless otherwise noted with employee parking signs. Accessible parking for persons with disabilities is available in front of the courthouse, as well as in the employee parking lot along the side.
courthouse.source_type: First Judicial Circuit official site (Gatsby SPA; rendered DOM extraction)

security.scope: Circuit-wide (all First Judicial Circuit courthouses including Santa Rosa)
security.screening: Everyone entering a court facility must pass through a security screening checkpoint. Allow ample time.
prohibited_items: Weapons or firearms (including sharp items: knives, scissors, needles, metal fingernail files, screwdrivers, and similar tools)
Hazardous materials, including any chemical devices
security.source_type: First Judicial Circuit official site (Gatsby SPA; rendered DOM extraction)

accommodations_ada.request_lead_time: Contact ADA Coordinator or Liaison at least 7 working days before court appearance

santa_rosa_ada_liaison.address: Court Administration, ADA Liaison, 4025 Avalon Blvd, Milton, FL 32583

auxiliary_aids_available: Large print, braille, or audio recording materials
not_required: Fundamental policy changes or undue burden accommodations
